grades.why: It says toHaveTextContent with a string passes on substring containment, which is the stale behavior, and never mentions toMatchTextContent.
It presents @vitest/browser-webdriverio as a current provider, which is the stale answer; the package was removed in Vitest 5, and the hedge about not checking docs doesn't fix that.
It says Vitest doesn't search parent directories for the config, matching the key, and doesn't present ancestor lookup as current.
It states the stale default folder .vitest-reports/ instead of the current .vitest/blob/.
It says inline projects don't inherit the root config unless `extends: true` is set, which is the stale behavior; the key says they inherit by default.
It says locators.exact is now on by default, so text must match exactly, and it describes substring matching only as the old Vitest 4 behavior.
It says Vitest has nothing built in and recommends vitest-when or a manual mockImplementation, which is the stale answer; it misses Vitest 5's built-in vi.when().

It says newer Vitest throws on a non-top-level vi.mock and that only older versions warned; its line about the call still being hoisted from beforeEach muddies this but doesn't replace the current fact.
It states that current Vitest joins suite and test names with `>` and describes the space separator only as pre-v5 behavior.
It says `vitest list` imports and runs test files to collect tests, which is the outdated behavior, and denies the static parsing that is now the default.
